non_claims: ring positions of the substituents and the C-6a configuration are not resolved
noraporphines (NH3 loss) and 7-substituted aporphines are outside this rule

notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author): the CH5N+CH3, CH5N+OCH3 and CH5N+CH4O losses are daughters of the CH3NH2-loss product, as the rule's two-step pathway says, so the claim can rest on one channel.

competitors.note: isomeric with N-methyl aporphines (tetrahydropalmatine and glaucine are both C21H25NO4); separated by RDA ions (doi:10.1016/j.apsb.2014.04.003)
1-benzyltetrahydroisoquinolines also lose CH3NH2 and then CH3OH (doi:10.1255/ejms.745)
thebaine-type morphinans lose CH3NH2 and then CH3OH (doi:10.1016/s1044-0305(03)00539-7)
